iceServers.description: Optional public STUN configuration passed to the browser's standard RTCIceServer interface. Omitted or empty means no ICE servers. Gathering starts only when a caller deliberately initiates a session. TURN and credentials are excluded.

supportedStreams.description: Discoverable media streams in SDP offer order. Directions describe the endpoint; the browser reverses SENDONLY and RECVONLY. Omitted means a legacy video SENDONLY stream.

dataChannels.description: Data channels the browser creates after media transceivers, using the standard RTCDataChannelInit options. Omitted means no data channels.

iceMode.description: Whether the endpoint expects a full offer up front or supports trickle ICE.

messageAuthorizationRequirements.description: Per-message authorization requirements for RTC session messages.
